sources.quote: the audit qualifies the company. Part approvals stay as they are.
SUP-C,Meccanica Chisone S.r.l.,aluminium extrusions and blanks
Agreed in writing with Aurelia (F. Marino).

findings.why: The re-audit restored SUP-C's standing as a company, but part approvals are separate. No controlled record in the documents covers SUP-C for HS-410 (stamped DC04 steel) at any receiving plant for the part's customer. The customer is inferred from DEV-121, which was agreed with Aurelia. SUP-C is listed as an aluminium extrusions and blanks supplier. Absence of a record is not proof of non-approval, so a person must confirm whether a current release exists.
